item.title: Nvidia's Board Is Investigating Its Own CEO — and the Shares Fell 4.5% Before the Market Opened
item.description: Nvidia said on 8 November it is opening an independent investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. The board says it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised; the shares fell 4.5% premarket.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Ramayana Crosses ₹500 Crore Worldwide in Four Days — and Monday Is Loading Bigger
item.description: Ramayana Part One collected ₹56.15 crore in India on Day 4 (Sunday, Diwali day), taking its 4-day India net to ₹238.85 crore and worldwide gross to ₹507.20 crore, per Sacnilk. Day 5 live tracking was already at ₹49.69 crore by 3:03 pm.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Delhi Woke Up to 368 AQI After Diwali — and a Fight Over Whether the Numbers Are Real
item.description: Delhi’s AQI was 368, “very poor”, at 7 am on Monday 9 November, a day after Diwali, with 15 of 54 stations “severe”. PM2.5 at Akshardham hit 760.99 µg/m³ — over 50 times the WHO guideline — and a political row has broken out over the data.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Govardhan Puja 2026: 9 or 10 November? The Correct Date, Muhurat and Vidhi
item.description: Govardhan Puja 2026: the main morning puja in India is Tuesday 10 November, 6:40–8:50 am in Delhi (Drik Panchang). Pratipada runs 12:31 pm on 9 Nov to 2:00 pm on 10 Nov — here is why the dates differ, and the vidhi.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Trump Says New Iran Strikes Are 'Highly Unlikely' — the Same Day Houthis Hit an Aramco Tower in Riyadh
item.description: Trump told CNN new US attacks on Iran were “highly unlikely” if talks produced a strong deal and Hormuz reopened — while Iran’s foreign minister said no negotiations had taken place, Rubio reported no progress, and Houthis struck an Aramco tower in Riyadh.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Ramayana Part One: Saturday Beat Day 1 — Rs 69.80 Crore Takes Three-Day Total to Rs 182.70 Crore
item.description: Ramayana Part One collected Rs 69.80 crore net in India on Saturday 7 November, beating its Rs 64.85 crore opening day. Day 2 finished at Rs 48.05 crore, taking the three-day India net to Rs 182.70 crore.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Delhi Diwali Morning: AQI 384 at 6 am, Rising to 483 by 8:10 am as the Green-Cracker Window Opens
item.description: Delhi woke on Diwali morning, 8 November, to an overall AQI of 384 at 6 am, very poor, with 11 of 23 stations above 400. A later CPCB reading put the city at 483 at 8:10 am. GRAP-III is in force and green crackers are allowed only on 7 and 8 November.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Sensex Has Its Best Week in Six Years: Up 8.82% as Foreign Money Pours Back While the Nasdaq Slides
item.description: The Sensex gained 8.82% and the Nifty 8.58% in the week to 6 November 2026 — their best week in about six years — as foreign investors net-bought Rs 45,960 crore. The Nasdaq fell 3.4% for the week, its fourth straight weekly decline.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: OpenAI Built an AI That Can Hack Linux 948 Ways — and Locked It Away on Day One
item.description: OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber found 81 flaws in Firefox nobody knew about and reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel vulnerabilities in the lab. It classified the model "Critical" — and decided almost nobody gets to use it.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Paraguay Removed Its President 44–0 — and Swore In His Successor the Same Day
item.description: Congress did not accept Santiago Peña’s resignation. The Senate removed him 44–0 on 6 November, Pedro Alliana was sworn in as president, and Peña was placed under house arrest over the ueno bank collapse.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Ronaldo Hands Back the No. 7 Shirt — After 234 Games, 146 Goals and 23 Years, Portugal's Greatest International Career Ends
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international football on 5 November 2026 in a video message, ending a 23-year Portugal career as the men's record holder with 234 caps and 146 goals — but the ending came after a fallout with coach Jorge Jesus and a 30-day federation suspension, not a planned farewell.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Ramayana Opens to Packed Houses and a Split Verdict — The First Numbers, the First Reviews, and What They Actually Mean
item.description: Ramayana: Part 1 opened on 5 November to packed houses and split reviews — The Guardian gave it 4/5, IGN 4/10 — with a confirmed Day 1 total of India net Rs 64.85 crore (gross Rs 77.50 crore), well below the Rs 75–100 crore opening-day projections for a film of its reported scale.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Kohli's 74 and Kamboj's 2/22: India Beat New Zealand in Rain-Hit Auckland ODI
item.description: India beat New Zealand by 5 wickets (DLS) in the rain-hit first ODI at Auckland, chasing a revised target of 143 in 32 overs; Virat Kohli made 74 off 51 — his 80th ODI fifty, passing Tendulkar in ODI chases — and Anshul Kamboj took 2/22 in only his second ODI to win Player of the Match.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: India Is Rethinking the Law That Lets Facebook and YouTube Say 'Not Our Post' — What Safe Harbour Is, and What Would Actually Change
item.description: The government has started talking about removing the legal shield that protects social media platforms from being blamed for what their users post. Nothing has been decided yet — MeitY's talks are exploratory, and any change would need Parliament to amend the IT Act.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Democrats Won Everything — So Why Can't They Just Pass Whatever They Want? The Midterms, After the Headlines
item.description: The Democrats took the House, the Senate and most governorships on 3 November — a real shift in power, but they are still short of the 60 Senate votes needed to beat a filibuster and the two-thirds needed to override a veto.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: From Kerala to Los Angeles City Hall: Nithya Raman Makes History as LA's First Indian-American Mayor
item.description: Kerala-born Nithya Raman, 45, beat incumbent Karen Bass 51.67% (405,193) to 48.33% (379,069) per the LA County Registrar, becoming Los Angeles' first Asian-American mayor and the first South Asian woman to lead the city.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Keisha Lance Bottoms Makes History: First Black Woman Elected Governor in America
item.description: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms, 56, former Atlanta mayor (2018–2022), beat billionaire Rick Jackson — who spent more than $200 million of his own money — to become the first Black woman elected governor of a US state, ending 24+ years of Republican control in Georgia.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: The AI Party Hit a Wall — Nasdaq Falls Into Correction as Chip Stocks Plunge a Day After the Midterms
item.description: The Nasdaq closed at 24,712.60 on 5 November 2026, down 3.9% on the day and more than 10% below its 6 October record close of 27,599.89 — a correction. AI and chip stocks led the fall a day after the post-midterms rally.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: 'Shift to Navi Mumbai or Stop Flying to Mumbai': Adani's Ultimatum to Foreign Airlines
item.description: Adani-owned Mumbai airport plans to shut Terminal 1 from April 2027 and shift 265 of 770 weekly international slots to Navi Mumbai, cutting capacity by 5 million passengers a year — and CEO Arun Bansal told foreign airlines to shift or suspend, while Emirates and Air France-KLM push back.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Bank of England Raises Rates to 4% — First Hike in Three Years as Middle East War Pushes Energy Prices Up
item.description: The Bank of England raised Bank Rate by 0.25 points, from 3.75% to 4%, on 5 November 2026 — its first hike since August 2023 — with the MPC voting 8–1 and warning at least one more increase was likely as Middle East conflict pushes energy prices up.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Agniveer Gets 2 More Years — And Now Every Agniveer Can Become a Regular Soldier
item.description: The Union Cabinet approved a second 2-year engagement for Agniveers after their initial 4 years; after 6 years, all willing Agniveers can be enrolled as regular soldiers with no numerical cap — reversing the old rule under which only 25% were retained.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: A Bank Collapsed, Half a Country Lost Its Money — and Paraguay's President Resigned
item.description: President Santiago Peña, 47, resigned on 5 November after the ueno digital bank collapse locked about 3 million Paraguayans out of their money; Congress accepted the resignation and Vice President Pedro Alliana assumed the presidency to complete the term through August 2028.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: US Sanctions Chandigarh Couple It Accuses of Helping Iran Sell Oil Through Fake Ship Papers
item.description: The US Treasury on 4 November sanctioned Chandigarh-based Suniel Kumar Sharma and wife Jaspreet Preeti Shahid, accused of running a network faking ship registries (Guyana, Laos and others) for vessels carrying Iranian petroleum, under Operation Economic Outcast and Executive Order 13902. All claims are presented as allegations, not proven in court.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: This Hyderabad Startup Will Clean Up Space Junk — India's First Private Space-Debris Facility Opens
item.description: Cosmoserve Space unveiled 'Base 1' in Hyderabad on 5 November, India's first private facility for space debris removal and satellite servicing, aiming to service up to 100 satellites and cut servicing cost from ~$10m to under $1m per satellite.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Sam Altman on Raj Shamani's Podcast: India Is ChatGPT's Biggest Market, and the Two Bets That Built OpenAI
item.description: In a 68-minute conversation released on 3 November 2026, OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman tells Raj Shamani why India, not the United States, now has the most ChatGPT users, how two huge bets shaped OpenAI, and why he worries most about AI power concentrating in too few hands.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Only 0.01% of People Know These Things — After Reading This, You Will Never See the World the Same Way Again
item.description: This is not secret knowledge, and it is not classified. It is public knowledge that very few people ever understand deeply. Read it in a few minutes, and you will join that small group.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Dhanteras 2026 on 6 November: Puja Muhurat in Delhi, Tithi Timings and What the Festival Means
item.description: Dhanteras, the first day of the five-day Diwali festival, falls on Friday 6 November 2026. In New Delhi the evening puja muhurat is 6:02 pm to 7:57 pm — but the exact minutes vary by city and panchang, so use the Delhi figure as a guide, not a universal clock time.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Virat Kohli Turns 38 on 5 November: A Birthday-Eve 74, a Cake at Eden Park, and 86 International Centuries
item.description: Virat Kohli celebrates his 38th birthday on Thursday 5 November 2026, in New Zealand, in the middle of a five-match ODI series — a day after a 74 off 51 balls carried India to a five-wicket win in the rain-hit first ODI at Eden Park, Auckland.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: India vs Pakistan in the SAFF Championship Opener on 5 November: Time, Venue and Where to Watch in India
item.description: Defending champions India open their SAFF Championship 2026 title defence against Pakistan at the National Stadium, Dhaka, on Thursday 5 November. In India the match streams on VETO, with no TV telecast.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Ramayana Part One Releases 5 November: Advance Bookings, Cast and the Pushpak Viman Row
item.description: Nitesh Tiwari's two-part retelling of Valmiki's epic opens worldwide on 5 November 2026, after advance bookings that trade trackers put above Rs 96 crore including blocked seats — and a promotional remark that turned into a debate of its own.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Delhi Air Turns Very Poor Before Diwali: AQI Timeline, GRAP Stage II and the Green-Cracker Order
item.description: Delhi's air crossed 250 on 1 November, then 300 into “very poor” on 2 November, reaching 350 on 3 November. The response so far is a mix of emergency curbs under GRAP Stage II and a tightly limited Supreme Court permission for green crackers on 7 and 8 November.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: US Midterms 2026: Democrats Flip Texas, Hold Georgia and Win Ohio Governor — What Is Projected, What Is Not
item.description: Election day was 3 November 2026. By 4 November, media projections showed a Democratic night led by a first statewide Texas win since 1994 — but projections are not certified results, and several races were still unsettled or conflicting between trackers.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: After Cyclone Murasu: 12,230 in Relief Centres, Power Restoration Under Way and a Storm Fading Over Telangana
item.description: Severe Cyclonic Storm Murasu crossed Andhra Pradesh near Ongole on 3 November, killing two people in Bapatla. By the morning of 4 November it had weakened to a depression over Telangana — but for the districts it hit hardest, recovery is only beginning, and every damage figure remains preliminary.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Jailer 2 Crosses Rs 800 Crore Worldwide: The First Tamil Film to Do It, in 18 Days
item.description: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 passed Rs 800 crore worldwide on its third Sunday, 1 November 2026 — its 18th day in theatres — with an estimated gross of Rs 807.25 crore. The milestone is a gross figure, not a net one, and it makes the film the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Cyclone Murasu Batters Andhra Pradesh: Two Dead, Crops and Homes Damaged in a Second Storm in a Week
item.description: Cyclone Murasu crossed Andhra Pradesh near Ongole on 3 November, killing two people in Bapatla, damaging 52,459 hectares of crops and 312 houses. Figures are preliminary.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Indian Navy Rescues 20 Crew From Hijacked Vessel Azini Off Somalia After a 48-Hour Operation
item.description: The Indian Navy rescued 20 crew from the Iranian fishing vessel Azini, hijacked off Somalia on 29 October, in a 48-hour operation more than 3,000 km from Mumbai.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: ISRO Launches NVS-03 on GSLV-F18 to Restore NavIC, India's Own Navigation System
item.description: ISRO launched the 2,232 kg NVS-03 satellite on GSLV-F18 on 30 October to strengthen NavIC. It is not yet in live service — commissioning is still pending.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: India Collected ₹2.31 Lakh Crore GST in October, the Second-Highest Ever, as Factory Output Grew 6.7%
item.description: India's GST collection in October 2026 was ₹2.31 lakh crore, up 22.9% year-on-year — the second-highest ever, not a record. Factory output grew 6.7% in September.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: AI's Bill Has Arrived: A $115 Billion Chip Deal, $895 Billion in Compute Promises, and Apple's Memory Warning
item.description: Marvell is buying Lumentum in a $115 billion enterprise-value deal, Anthropic disclosed about $895.4 billion in compute commitments, and Apple warned on memory costs.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: 51 Indian Startups Worth ₹3.3 Lakh Crore Are One Step From Unicorn Status, Led by AI, Rockets and Drones
item.description: The Hurun India Gazelle Index 2026 lists 51 startups valued $500 million to $1 billion, worth about ₹3.3 lakh crore combined, with Bengaluru leading at 17.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Australia Lifts Rates to 4.85%: A Split Vote at an 18-Year High
item.description: On 3 November 2026, Australia’s central bank raised borrowing costs for the fifth time this year, even as unemployment rose and house prices fell. The split vote is the real signal.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Fables in Fashion 2026: Wahy Al-Qalam Becomes Clothes, Colour and Art in Doha
item.description: A book of essays has left the page in Doha. Seven designers and 30 artists have turned its ideas into garments, textiles and visual art — and the result says as much about how we read now as about the book itself.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: The New Startup Bet Is Not Another App: It Is Antennas, Thrusters and Factories
item.description: Two large rounds on 2 November 2026, for a satellite ground network and for hypersonic systems, point to the same shift: startup capital is moving from software alone into the physical systems underneath it.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Passkeys Are Quietly Ending the Password
item.description: A passkey replaces the secret you type with a key your device keeps. It is faster to use, harder to steal, and still far from universal — which is why the password is fading slowly, not disappearing overnight.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: COP31 in Antalya: Two Presidents, One Climate Test
item.description: The world’s biggest climate talks open in Antalya on 9 November with an unusual arrangement: one country hosts, another leads the negotiations, and both must prove the split can work.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Hurricane Polo Explodes to Category 5
item.description: In under 24 hours the system went from tropical storm to a 180 mph monster with 892 mb pressure. Live track, rainfall threats for Mexico, and the next 48 hours.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Shelley Fabares, 'Coach' & 'Donna Reed Show' Star
item.description: The Emmy-nominated actress and "Johnny Angel" singer passed away Saturday in Los Angeles, surrounded by husband Mike Farrell and family, who have asked for privacy as tributes arrive from co-star Craig T. Nelson and fans of classic television.

item.description: An in-depth research breakdown on how emerging news topics are identified, tracked, and projected to trend on Google Search within a 24 to 48-hour timeframe.

item.title: Generative AI Startup Funding Trends: Investment Capital, Valuations, and Market Dynamics
item.description: An in-depth analysis of investment capital distribution, valuation multiples, revenue benchmarks, and strategic funding trends across the global startup ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: AI Is Eating Software: How Agentic AI Is Quietly Replacing the Cloud
item.description: Developers are pulling AI workloads off rented GPUs and back onto their own machines — trading a monthly API invoice for a quantized model that never phones home.

item.description: While global regulators step up scrutiny on non-transparent data practices, millions of web users remain unaware of what lies inside updated terms of service.
